attempts.summary: Configured a nightly 01:30 backup from node2 to node1 using installed tar, OpenSSH, cron, find, and flock. Archives use inventory-YYYY-MM-DD.tar.gz under /var/backups/inventory and retain seven calendar days. Both nodes restarted sequentially and recovered with changed boot IDs. The requested source was initially absent, so it was created; the final archive correctly contains its currently empty data directory.
